source.title: fix(k8s): hold the copy source until the destination ends (#3712)

criteria: The source side of the copy does not end before the destination has the data. Prefer a rule that depends on the destination, such as a source that holds until the destination ended, over a fixed wait. A fixed wait is acceptable only with a measure that states why its length is sufficient.
The command still runs through `run_subprocess`, and the plan, the dry run and the run list the same steps.
A live measure with temporary pods gives at least 20 complete copies of 20, with the numbers in the pull request.
`openspec/specs/` and the volume move section of `k8s/README.md` state the rule.
